title: 📌 National Strategic Infrastructure — Kavach 4.0 472 km Rollout, Kaziranga Corridor & NSHIP TN
summary: PM Modi laid foundation for 85.675 km 4-lane EPC Kaziranga Elevated Corridor on NH-715 (₹6,950 Cr) to protect wildlife and connect Upper Assam.

blocks.content: **Overview**: PM Modi laid foundation for 85.675 km 4-lane EPC Kaziranga Elevated Corridor on NH-715 (₹6,950 Cr) to protect wildlife and connect Upper Assam.

items: **PM Modi Performs Bhoomi Pujan for ₹6,950 Crore Kaziranga Elevated Corridor (NH-715)** (Page 72): PM Modi laid foundation for 85.675 km 4-lane EPC Kaziranga Elevated Corridor on NH-715 (₹6,950 Cr) to protect wildlife and connect Upper Assam.

**VOC Port and SIPCOT Form NSHIP TN to Build ₹19,989 Crore Mega Shipbuilding Park** (Page 87): VOC Port and SIPCOT created 50:50 SPV National Shipbuilding & Heavy Industries Park, Tamil Nadu (NSHIP) under Shipping Ministry’s ₹19,989 Cr scheme to expand capacity to 4.5M GT.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under National Multi-Modal & Transport Infrastructure. 472 km single-day Kavach 4.0 commissioning (total >1,300 km), ₹6,950 Cr Kaziranga elevated highway, and ₹19,989 Cr NSHIP TN shipbuilding SPV.
